```{r}
#Question 1: Does high quality vinho verde red wines (quality >5) have a significantly higher alcohol content compared to wines with low quality. 


wine = read.csv("C:/Users/abasa/Downloads/winequality-red.csv")
length(wine$alcohol)

fav_stats(wine$quality)
# min = 3;  max = 8
```

```{r}
# Created two bins [0-5) and [5,10]
wine = wine %>%
  mutate(binary_quality = cut(quality, breaks = c(0,5,10), labels = c("Low", "High")))

wine
```

```{r}

# Check normality assumptions
qqnorm(wine$alcohol);qqline(wine$alcohol) # Not visually apparent. Recourse to numeric test

shapiro.test(wine$alcohol) # p-value < 0.00000000000000022, suggesting data are not normal
# We will therefore use a permutation test to compare means 

```
```{r}
qqnorm(wine$alcohol[wine$binary_quality == "High"]);qqline(wine$alcohol[wine$binary_quality == "High"])
```
```{r}
shapiro.test(wine$alcohol[wine$binary_quality == "High"])
```
```{r}

qqnorm(wine$alcohol[wine$binary_quality == "Low"]);qqline(wine$alcohol[wine$binary_quality == "Low"])
shapiro.test(wine$alcohol[wine$binary_quality == "Low"])
```




```{r}
# Find means of both samples (low vs high quality wine)
favstats(data = wine, alcohol~binary_quality)


```

```{r}
# Null hypothesis: mean alcohol quantity of high quality wines - mean alcohol quantity of low quality wines <= 0
# Alternate: mean alcohol quantity of high quality wines - mean alcohol quantity of low quality wines > 0
threshold = 10.855029 - 9.926478 
threshold # 0.928551
# Permutation test with 5000 iterations

length(wine$alcohol) # 1599
table(wine$binary_quality) # High = 855;  Low = 744
#sample_space = c(rep(1))

N=4999
permvector = numeric(N)
for (i in 1:N)
{
  index = sample(1599, 855, replace = FALSE)
  permvector[i] = mean(wine$alcohol[index])-mean(wine$alcohol[-index])

}
# finding p-value for right-tailed hypothesis test
(sum(permvector>= threshold)+1)/(N+1) # 0.0002

# p < 0.05. Therefore, we reject the Null hypothesis and conclude that the probability of another sample wherein mean alcohol quantity of high quality wines - mean alcohol quantity of low quality wines >= 0.928551 is 0.02 %


```
```{r}
# Bootstrap CI for mean differences alcohol
set.seed (1111)
bootvector = numeric(5000)
low_col = wine$alcohol[wine$binary_quality == "Low"]
high_col = wine$alcohol[wine$binary_quality == "High"]

for ( i in 1: length(bootvector))
{
  low_qual = mean(sample(low_col, length(low_col), replace = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  high_qual = mean(sample(high_col, length(high_col), replace = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  bootvector[i] = high_qual - low_qual
}

bootvector.df = data.frame(bootvector)

ggplot(bootvector.df, aes(x = bootvector))+
  geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(density)), col = "black", fill = "skyblue")+
  geom_density(col = "red", size = 1.2)+
  theme_minimal()+
    labs(
    title = "Bootstrap Distribution of Mean Alcohol Differences",
    subtitle = "High-quality minus Low-quality Vinho Verde Red Wines",
    x = "Mean Difference in Alcohol Content (High - Low)",
    y = "Density"
  )
  
qdata(~bootvector, p = c(0.025,0.975), data = bootvector.df)

```


```{r}

```


```{r}
# Histogram visualization of permutation vector
set.seed(9999)
permvector.df = data.frame(permvector)
ggplot(permvector.df, aes(x=permvector))+
  geom_histogram(aes(y=after_stat(density)), col = "black", fill = "skyblue")+
  geom_density(col = "red", size = 1.2)+
  theme_minimal()+
    labs(
    title = "Permutation Distribution of Mean Alcohol Differences",
    subtitle = "High-quality vs Low-quality Vinho Verde Red Wines",
    x = "Mean Difference in Alcohol Content (High - Low)",
    y = "Density"
  )
  
```

```{r}
# CI estimation (95%)
qdata(~permvector, data = permvector.df, p = c(0.025,0.975) ) # [-0.1061665,  0.1063355]
```

```{r}
# Extra visualisations

ggplot(wine, aes(x = binary_quality, y = alcohol, fill = binary_quality)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +

  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +

    x = "Quality Category",
    y = "Alcohol (% by volume)",
    fill = "Quality"
  ) +

    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray30"),
    legend.position = "none",         # remove if legend not needed
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
